env_vars.purpose: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (e.g. `https://app.example.com,https://admin.example.com`). Defaults to `*` (all origins) when not set

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DD_AGENT_HOST
env_vars.purpose: Hostname or IP of DataDog agent for LiteLLM-specific logging. When set, logs are sent to agent instead of direct API

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT
env_vars.purpose: Environment name for the deployment (e.g., "production", "staging"). Used as a fallback when OTEL_ENVIRONMENT_NAME is not set. Sets the `environment` tag in telemetry data

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DETAILED_TIMING
env_vars.purpose: When true, adds detailed per-phase timing headers to responses (`x-litellm-timing-{pre-processing,llm-api,post-processing,message-copy}-ms`). Default is false. See [latency overhead docs](../troubleshoot/latency_overhead.md)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DD_AGENT_PORT
env_vars.purpose: Port of DataDog agent for LiteLLM-specific log intake. Default is 10518

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DD_LLM_OBS_PORT
env_vars.purpose: Port for Datadog LLM Observability agent. Default is 8126

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_ENCODING_FORMAT
env_vars.purpose: Default `encoding_format` for OpenAI-compatible embedding calls when it is not set on the request or in model `litellm_params` (e.g. `float`, `base64`). Fallback is `float`. See [Embeddings](./embedding.md#embedding-encoding-format).

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DEV_ENV_HOT_RELOAD
env_vars.purpose: Internal flag the proxy sets on itself when started with `--reload`, signalling reloaded workers to re-read `.env` with `override=True` so edits to existing keys take effect on reload. Not meant to be set by users

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DONT_SHOW_FEEDBACK_BOX
env_vars.purpose: Flag to hide feedback box in LiteLLM UI

env_vars.name: LITELLM_MODIFY_PARAMS
env_vars.purpose: Parameters to modify in LiteLLM requests

env_vars.name: LITELLM_EMAIL
env_vars.purpose: Email associated with LiteLLM account

env_vars.name: LITELLM_FAVICON_URL
env_vars.purpose: Custom URL for the LiteLLM UI favicon. When set, overrides the default favicon

env_vars.name: LITELLM_GLOBAL_MAX_PARALLEL_REQUEST_RETRIES
env_vars.purpose: Maximum retries for parallel requests in LiteLLM

env_vars.name: LITELLM_GLOBAL_MAX_PARALLEL_REQUEST_RETRY_TIMEOUT
env_vars.purpose: Timeout for retries of parallel requests in LiteLLM

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DISABLE_ACCESS_LOG_PATHS
env_vars.purpose: Comma-separated list of URL paths to exclude from uvicorn access logs (e.g., `/health,/metrics`). Useful for suppressing noisy health-check log entries.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DISABLE_LAZY_LOADING
env_vars.purpose: When set to "1", "true", "yes", or "on", disables lazy loading of attributes (currently only affects encoding/tiktoken). This ensures encoding is initialized before VCR starts recording HTTP requests, fixing VCR cassette creation issues. See [issue #18659](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/18659)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_DISABLE_REDACT_SECRETS
env_vars.purpose: When set to "true", disables automatic redaction of secrets (API keys, tokens, credentials) from proxy log output. Secret redaction is enabled by default.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_MIGRATION_DIR
env_vars.purpose: Custom migrations directory for prisma migrations, used for baselining db in read-only file systems.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_HOSTED_UI
env_vars.purpose: URL of the hosted UI for LiteLLM

env_vars.name: LITELLM_UI_API_DOC_BASE_URL
env_vars.purpose: Optional override for the API Reference base URL (used in sample code/docs) when the admin UI runs on a different host than the proxy. Defaults to `PROXY_BASE_URL` when unset.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_UI_PATH
env_vars.purpose: Path to directory for Admin UI files. Used when running with read-only filesystem (e.g., Kubernetes). Default is `/var/lib/litellm/ui` in Docker.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_UI_SESSION_DURATION
env_vars.purpose: Duration for UI login session (username/password, SSO, invitation links). Format: "30s", "30m", "24h", "7d". Does not apply to EXPERIMENTAL_UI_LOGIN flow, which uses a fixed 10-minute expiry for security. Default is "24h"

env_vars.name: LITELLM_EXPIRED_UI_SESSION_KEY_CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of expired LiteLLM dashboard session keys to delete per cleanup run. Default is 1000.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_EXPIRED_UI_SESSION_KEY_CLEANUP_ENABLED
env_vars.purpose: Set to `true` to enable the background cleanup job for expired LiteLLM dashboard session keys. Default is `false`.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_EXPIRED_UI_SESSION_KEY_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Interval in seconds for how often to run the expired LiteLLM dashboard session key cleanup job. Default is 86400 (24 hours).

env_vars.name: LITELM_ENVIRONMENT
env_vars.purpose: Environment of LiteLLM Instance, used by logging services. Currently only used by DeepEval.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_KEY_ROTATION_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: TTL in seconds for the distributed lock used by the key rotation job. Default is 600 (10 minutes).

env_vars.name: LITELLM_LOCAL_ANTHROPIC_BETA_HEADERS
env_vars.purpose: Set to `True` to use the local bundled Anthropic beta headers config only, disabling remote fetching. Default is `False`

env_vars.name: LITELLM_OIDC_ALLOWED_CREDENTIAL_DIRS
env_vars.purpose: Comma-separated list of absolute directories from which the `oidc/file/` provider is permitted to read token files. Defaults to `/var/run/secrets,/run/secrets`.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_LOCAL_BLOG_POSTS
env_vars.purpose: When set to `True`, uses the local bundled blog posts only, disabling remote fetching from GitHub. Default is `False`

env_vars.name: LITELLM_LOCAL_POLICY_TEMPLATES
env_vars.purpose: When set to "true", uses local backup policy templates instead of fetching from GitHub. Policy templates are fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/main/policy_templates.json by default, with automatic fallback to local backup on failure

env_vars.name: LITELLM_MODEL_COST_MAP_URL
env_vars.purpose: URL for fetching model cost map data. Default is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/main/model_prices_and_context_window.json

env_vars.name: LITELLM_LOG_FILE
env_vars.purpose: File path to write LiteLLM logs to. When set, logs will be written to both console and the specified file

env_vars.name: LITELLM_LOGGER_NAME
env_vars.purpose: Name for OTEL logger

env_vars.name: LITELLM_METER_NAME
env_vars.purpose: Name for OTEL Meter

env_vars.name: LITELLM_OTEL_INTEGRATION_ENABLE_EVENTS
env_vars.purpose: Optionally enable semantic logs (`gen_ai.content.prompt`/`gen_ai.content.completion`, or `gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details` in semconv mode) for OTEL. Default `false`. See [OpenTelemetry](/docs/observability/opentelemetry_integration#configuration-reference)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_OTEL_INTEGRATION_ENABLE_METRICS
env_vars.purpose: Optionally enable semantic metrics (TTFT, TPOT, response duration, cost, token usage) for OTEL. Default `false`. See [OpenTelemetry](/docs/observability/opentelemetry_integration#metrics-reference)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_OTEL_BAGGAGE_TEAM_METADATA_KEYS
env_vars.purpose: Comma-separated allowlist of team-metadata sub-keys promoted onto OTEL spans under `litellm.team.metadata`. Empty by default, so none of a team's free-form metadata is sent to your tracing backend until each sub-key is explicitly allowlisted. Also settable as `baggage_team_metadata_keys` under `callback_settings.otel` in config.yaml. See [OpenTelemetry](/docs/observability/opentelemetry_integration).

env_vars.name: LITELLM_ENABLE_PYROSCOPE
env_vars.purpose: If true, enables Pyroscope CPU profiling. Profiles are sent to PYROSCOPE_SERVER_ADDRESS. Off by default. See [Pyroscope profiling](/proxy/pyroscope_profiling).

env_vars.name: LITELLM_ENABLE_TEAM_STALE_ALIAS_BYPASS
env_vars.purpose: When `true`, if a team's legacy `model_aliases` entry maps a public model name to an internal `model_name_<team_id>_<uuid>` deployment, pre-call handling can skip that rewrite when team-scoped sibling deployments exist for the public name—so load balancing / `order` apply across siblings. Default is `false` for backwards compatibility. See [Team-scoped models and legacy aliases](./load_balancing#team-scoped-models-and-legacy-model_aliases). When stale aliases are detected and this flag is off, the proxy may log a one-time warning.

env_vars.name: PYROSCOPE_APP_NAME
env_vars.purpose: Application name reported to Pyroscope. Required when LITELLM_ENABLE_PYROSCOPE is true. No default.

env_vars.name: PYROSCOPE_SERVER_ADDRESS
env_vars.purpose: Pyroscope server URL to send profiles to. Required when LITELLM_ENABLE_PYROSCOPE is true. No default.

env_vars.name: PYROSCOPE_SAMPLE_RATE
env_vars.purpose: Optional. Sample rate for Pyroscope profiling (integer). No default; when unset, the pyroscope-io library default is used.

env_vars.name: PYROSCOPE_GRAFANA_USER
env_vars.purpose: Optional. Grafana Cloud Pyroscope user/tenant ID for basic auth. Required when PYROSCOPE_GRAFANA_API_TOKEN is set.

env_vars.name: PYROSCOPE_GRAFANA_API_TOKEN
env_vars.purpose: Optional. Grafana Cloud API/access policy token for Pyroscope basic auth. Required when PYROSCOPE_GRAFANA_USER is set.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_MAX_BUDGET_PER_SESSION_TTL
env_vars.purpose: TTL in seconds for session budget counters used by the max-budget-per-session limiter. Default is 3600 (1 hour)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_MAX_ITERATIONS_TTL
env_vars.purpose: TTL in seconds for session iteration counters used by the max-iterations limiter. Default is 3600 (1 hour)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_MAX_STREAMING_DURATION_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Maximum duration in seconds allowed for a streaming response. Streams exceeding this duration are terminated with a Timeout error. Default is None (no limit)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_STREAM_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Maximum seconds to wait for the next chunk from an async streaming provider before raising a Timeout. Guards against a provider that keeps the connection warm with keepalive bytes but stops sending content. Default is None (disabled)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_MODE
env_vars.purpose: Operating mode for LiteLLM (e.g., production, development)

env_vars.name: LITELLM_NON_ROOT
env_vars.purpose: Flag to run LiteLLM in non-root mode for enhanced security in Docker containers

env_vars.name: LITELLM_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SIZE
env_vars.purpose: Rate limit window size for LiteLLM. Default is 60

env_vars.name: LITELLM_REASONING_AUTO_SUMMARY
env_vars.purpose: If set to "true", automatically enables detailed reasoning summaries (`summary: "detailed"`) for reasoning models across all translation paths (Anthropic adapter, Responses API, etc.). Default is "false"

env_vars.name: LITELLM_SENSITIVE_ROUTING_TTL
env_vars.purpose: TTL in seconds for sticky sensitive-data routing decisions; controls how long a session stays pinned to the on-premise model selected by a routing guardrail. Default is 3600

env_vars.name: LITELLM_SSL_CIPHERS
env_vars.purpose: SSL/TLS cipher configuration for faster handshakes. Controls cipher suite preferences for OpenSSL connections.

env_vars.name: LITELLM_SECRET_AWS_KMS_LITELLM_LICENSE
env_vars.purpose: AWS KMS encrypted license for LiteLLM

env_vars.name: LITELLM_TOKEN
env_vars.purpose: Access token for LiteLLM integration

env_vars.name: LITELLM_TPM_TOKEN_RESERVATION_ENABLED
env_vars.purpose: When false, the v3 rate limiter skips the upfront TPM token reservation and enforces TPM post-call from actual usage. Default is true

env_vars.name: LITELLM_GEMINI_LIVE_DEFER_SETUP
env_vars.purpose: When set to "true", defers Gemini/Vertex Live setup until the client sends `session.update` (required for runtime tool injection). Default is "false" for backwards compatibility, which auto-sends setup on connect. Can also be set via `litellm.gemini_live_defer_setup`

env_vars.name: LITELLM_USE_LEGACY_INTERACTIONS_SCHEMA
env_vars.purpose: When set to "true", uses the legacy Google Interactions API schema (`outputs` array, `2026-05-07` revision) instead of the new schema (`steps` array, `2026-05-20` revision). The legacy schema will be sunset on June 8, 2026. Can also be set via `litellm_settings.use_legacy_interactions_schema`

env_vars.name: LITELLM_USER_AGENT
env_vars.purpose: Custom user agent string for LiteLLM API requests. Used for partner telemetry attribution

env_vars.name: LITELLM_PRINT_STANDARD_LOGGING_PAYLOAD
env_vars.purpose: If true, prints the standard logging payload to the console - useful for debugging

env_vars.name: LITELLM_ASYNCIO_QUEUE_MAXSIZE
env_vars.purpose: Maximum size for asyncio queues (e.g. log queues, spend update queues, and cookbook examples such as realtime audio in `nova_sonic_realtime.py`). Bounds in-memory growth to prevent OOM. Default is 1000.

env_vars.name: LOGFIRE_TOKEN
env_vars.purpose: Token for Logfire logging service

env_vars.name: LOGFIRE_BASE_URL
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Logfire logging service (useful for self hosted deployments)

env_vars.name: LOGGING_WORKER_CONCURRENCY
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of concurrent coroutine slots for the logging worker on the asyncio event loop. Default is 100. Setting too high will flood the event loop with logging tasks which will lower the overall latency of the requests.

env_vars.name: LOGGING_WORKER_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE
env_vars.purpose: Maximum size of the logging worker queue. When the queue is full, the worker aggressively clears tasks to make room instead of dropping logs. Default is 50,000

env_vars.name: LOGGING_WORKER_MAX_TIME_PER_COROUTINE
env_vars.purpose: Maximum time in seconds allowed for each coroutine in the logging worker before timing out. Default is 20.0

env_vars.name: LOGGING_WORKER_CLEAR_PERCENTAGE
env_vars.purpose: Percentage of the queue to extract when clearing. Default is 50%

env_vars.name: MAX_BASE64_LENGTH_FOR_LOGGING
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of base64 characters to keep in logging payloads. Data URIs exceeding this are replaced with a size placeholder. Set to 0 to disable truncation. Default is 64

env_vars.name: MAX_COMPETITOR_NAMES
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of competitor names allowed in policy template enrichment. Default is 100

env_vars.name: MAX_EXCEPTION_MESSAGE_LENGTH
env_vars.purpose: Maximum length for exception messages. Default is 2000

env_vars.name: MAX_ITERATIONS_TO_CLEAR_QUEUE
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of iterations to attempt when clearing the logging worker queue during shutdown. Default is 200

env_vars.name: MAX_TIME_TO_CLEAR_QUEUE
env_vars.purpose: Maximum time in seconds to spend clearing the logging worker queue during shutdown. Default is 5.0

env_vars.name: LOGGING_WORKER_AGGRESSIVE_CLEAR_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Cooldown time in seconds before allowing another aggressive clear operation when the queue is full. Default is 0.5

env_vars.name: MAX_STRING_LENGTH_PROMPT_IN_DB
env_vars.purpose: Maximum length for strings in spend logs when sanitizing request bodies. Strings longer than this will be truncated. Default is 1000

env_vars.name: MAX_IN_MEMORY_QUEUE_FLUSH_COUNT
env_vars.purpose: Maximum count for in-memory queue flush operations. Default is 1000

env_vars.name: MAX_IMAGE_URL_DOWNLOAD_SIZE_MB
env_vars.purpose: Maximum size in MB for downloading images from URLs. Prevents memory issues from downloading very large images. Images exceeding this limit will be rejected before download. Set to 0 to completely disable image URL handling (all image_url requests will be blocked). Default is 50MB (matching [OpenAI's limit](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/images-vision?api-mode=chat#image-input-requirements))

env_vars.name: MAX_LONG_SIDE_FOR_IMAGE_HIGH_RES
env_vars.purpose: Maximum length for the long side of high-resolution images. Default is 2000

env_vars.name: MAX_REDIS_BUFFER_DEQUEUE_COUNT
env_vars.purpose: Maximum count for Redis buffer dequeue operations. Default is 100

env_vars.name: MAX_SHORT_SIDE_FOR_IMAGE_HIGH_RES
env_vars.purpose: Maximum length for the short side of high-resolution images. Default is 768

env_vars.name: MAX_SIZE_IN_MEMORY_QUEUE
env_vars.purpose: Maximum size for in-memory queue. Default is 10000

env_vars.name: MAX_SIZE_PER_ITEM_IN_MEMORY_CACHE_IN_KB
env_vars.purpose: Maximum size in KB for each item in memory cache. Default is 512 or 1024

env_vars.name: MAX_SPENDLOG_ROWS_TO_QUERY
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of spend log rows to query. Default is 1,000,000

env_vars.name: MAX_TEAM_LIST_LIMIT
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of teams to list. Default is 20

env_vars.name: MAX_TILE_HEIGHT
env_vars.purpose: Maximum height for image tiles. Default is 512

env_vars.name: MAX_TILE_WIDTH
env_vars.purpose: Maximum width for image tiles. Default is 512

env_vars.name: MAX_TOKEN_TRIMMING_ATTEMPTS
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of attempts to trim a token message. Default is 10

env_vars.name: MAXIMUM_TRACEBACK_LINES_TO_LOG
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of lines to log in traceback in LiteLLM Logs UI. Default is 100

env_vars.name: MAX_RETRY_DELAY
env_vars.purpose: Maximum delay in seconds for retrying requests. Default is 8.0

env_vars.name: MAX_LANGFUSE_INITIALIZED_CLIENTS
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of Langfuse clients to initialize on proxy. Default is 50. This is set since langfuse initializes 1 thread everytime a client is initialized. We've had an incident in the past where we reached 100% cpu utilization because Langfuse was initialized several times.

env_vars.name: MAX_MCP_SEMANTIC_FILTER_TOOLS_HEADER_LENGTH
env_vars.purpose: Maximum header length for MCP semantic filter tools. Default is 150

env_vars.name: MAX_POLICY_ESTIMATE_IMPACT_ROWS
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of rows returned when estimating the impact of a policy. Default is 1000

env_vars.name: MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE_FOR_DEBUG_LOG
env_vars.purpose: Maximum payload size in bytes for full DEBUG serialization. Payloads exceeding this will be truncated in logs. Default is 102400 (100 KB)

env_vars.name: MIN_NON_ZERO_TEMPERATURE
env_vars.purpose: Minimum non-zero temperature value. Default is 0.0001

env_vars.name: MINIMUM_PROMPT_CACHE_TOKEN_COUNT
env_vars.purpose: Minimum token count for caching a prompt. Default is 1024

env_vars.name: MISTRAL_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Mistral API. Default is https://api.mistral.ai

env_vars.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Mistral API

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT
env_vars.purpose: Custom authorization endpoint URL for Microsoft SSO (overrides default Microsoft OAuth authorization endpoint)

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
env_vars.purpose: Client ID for Microsoft services

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
env_vars.purpose: Client secret for Microsoft services

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_ID
env_vars.purpose: Service Principal ID for Microsoft Enterprise Application. (This is an advanced feature if you want litellm to auto-assign members to Litellm Teams based on their Microsoft Entra ID Groups)

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_TENANT
env_vars.purpose: Tenant ID for Microsoft Azure

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_TOKEN_ENDPOINT
env_vars.purpose: Custom token endpoint URL for Microsoft SSO (overrides default Microsoft OAuth token endpoint)

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_USER_DISPLAY_NAME_ATTRIBUTE
env_vars.purpose: Field name for user display name in Microsoft SSO response. Default is `displayName`

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_USER_EMAIL_ATTRIBUTE
env_vars.purpose: Field name for user email in Microsoft SSO response. Default is `userPrincipalName`

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_USER_FIRST_NAME_ATTRIBUTE
env_vars.purpose: Field name for user first name in Microsoft SSO response. Default is `givenName`

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_USER_ID_ATTRIBUTE
env_vars.purpose: Field name for user ID in Microsoft SSO response. Default is `id`

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_USER_LAST_NAME_ATTRIBUTE
env_vars.purpose: Field name for user last name in Microsoft SSO response. Default is `surname`

env_vars.name: MICROSOFT_USERINFO_ENDPOINT
env_vars.purpose: Custom userinfo endpoint URL for Microsoft SSO (overrides default Microsoft Graph userinfo endpoint)

env_vars.name: MODEL_COST_MAP_MAX_SHRINK_RATIO
env_vars.purpose: Maximum allowed shrinkage ratio when validating a fetched model cost map against the local backup. Rejects the fetched map if it is smaller than this fraction of the backup. Default is 0.5

env_vars.name: MODEL_COST_MAP_MIN_MODEL_COUNT
env_vars.purpose: Minimum number of models a fetched cost map must contain to be considered valid. Default is 50

env_vars.name: NEW_RELIC_APP_NAME
env_vars.purpose: Application name for New Relic AI Monitoring integration

env_vars.name: NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY
env_vars.purpose: License key for New Relic authentication

env_vars.name: NO_OPENAPI
env_vars.purpose: Flag to disable the /openapi.json endpoint

env_vars.name: NON_LLM_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for non-LLM service connections. Default is 15

env_vars.name: OAUTH_TOKEN_INFO_ENDPOINT
env_vars.purpose: Endpoint for OAuth token info retrieval

env_vars.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for OpenAI API

env_vars.name: OPENAI_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for OpenAI API. Default is https://api.openai.com/

env_vars.name: OPENAI_CHATGPT_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Alternative to CHATGPT_API_BASE. Base URL for ChatGPT API

env_vars.name: OPENAI_FILE_SEARCH_COST_PER_1K_CALLS
env_vars.purpose: Cost per 1000 calls for OpenAI file search. Default is 0.0025

env_vars.name: OPENAI_ORGANIZATION
env_vars.purpose: Organization identifier for OpenAI

env_vars.name: OPENAPI_URL
env_vars.purpose: The path to the OpenAPI JSON endpoint. **By default this is "/openapi.json"**

env_vars.name: OPENID_BASE_URL
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for OpenID Connect services

env_vars.name: OPENID_CLIENT_ID
env_vars.purpose: Client ID for OpenID Connect authentication

env_vars.name: OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET
env_vars.purpose: Client secret for OpenID Connect authentication

env_vars.name: OPENMETER_API_ENDPOINT
env_vars.purpose: API endpoint for OpenMeter integration

env_vars.name: OPENMETER_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for OpenMeter services

env_vars.name: OPENMETER_EVENT_TYPE
env_vars.purpose: Type of events sent to OpenMeter

env_vars.name: OPENMETER_TRUST_REQUEST_USER
env_vars.purpose: If false, ignore the request body `user` and resolve the OpenMeter subject from the authenticated key's user_id. Defaults to true

env_vars.name: ONYX_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Onyx Security AI Guard service (defaults to https://ai-guard.onyx.security)

env_vars.name: ONYX_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Onyx Security AI Guard service

env_vars.name: ONYX_TIMEOUT
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for Onyx Guard server requests. Default is 10

env_vars.name: OTEL_ENVIRONMENT_NAME
env_vars.purpose: Environment name for OpenTelemetry

env_vars.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL
env_vars.purpose: Exporter type for OpenTelemetry

env_vars.name: OTEL_MODEL_ID
env_vars.purpose: Model ID for OpenTelemetry tracing

env_vars.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
env_vars.purpose: Headers for OpenTelemetry requests

env_vars.name: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER
env_vars.purpose: Exporter type for OpenTelemetry logs (e.g., console)

env_vars.name: OTEL_IGNORE_CONTEXT_PROPAGATION
env_vars.purpose: When true, ignore parent span context propagation (inbound `traceparent` headers and any active span) so every LiteLLM trace is its own root. Default `false`

env_vars.name: OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT
env_vars.purpose: Controls whether prompts and completions are captured in OpenTelemetry traces. Accepts `NO_CONTENT` (default per spec), `SPAN_ONLY`, `EVENT_ONLY`, `SPAN_AND_EVENT`, or the boolean form (`true` maps to `EVENT_ONLY`, `false` to `NO_CONTENT`)

env_vars.name: OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN
env_vars.purpose: Set to `gen_ai_latest_experimental` to emit spans following the latest [OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/gen-ai-spans/). Renames the LLM-call span to `{operation} {model}`, suppresses `raw_gen_ai_request`, adds `gen_ai.provider.name`, and consolidates events. Comma-separable per OTEL spec

env_vars.name: USE_OTEL_LITELLM_REQUEST_SPAN
env_vars.purpose: When `true`, the proxy emits a discrete `litellm_request` span per LLM call as a child of the `Received Proxy Server Request` span. Default `false` (since v1.81.0); LLM-call attributes are set directly on the proxy root span. See [Why don't I see a `litellm_request` span?](/docs/observability/opentelemetry_integration#why-dont-i-see-a-litellm_request-span)

env_vars.name: OTEL_DEBUG
env_vars.purpose: When `true`, prints exporter and span-creation diagnostics to stderr. Useful when traces aren't reaching your backend. Default `false`

env_vars.name: PAGERDUTY_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for PagerDuty Alerting

env_vars.name: PANW_PRISMA_AIRS_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for PANW Prisma AIRS service

env_vars.name: PANW_PRISMA_AIRS_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for PANW Prisma AIRS service

env_vars.name: PHOENIX_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Arize Phoenix

env_vars.name: PHOENIX_COLLECTOR_ENDPOINT
env_vars.purpose: API endpoint for Arize Phoenix

env_vars.name: PHOENIX_COLLECTOR_HTTP_ENDPOINT
env_vars.purpose: API http endpoint for Arize Phoenix

env_vars.name: PILLAR_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Pillar API Guardrails

env_vars.name: PILLAR_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Pillar API Guardrails

env_vars.name: PILLAR_ON_FLAGGED_ACTION
env_vars.purpose: Action to take when content is flagged ('block' or 'monitor')

env_vars.name: PKCE_STRICT_CACHE_MISS
env_vars.purpose: When set to `true`, the SSO callback will return a 401 error if the PKCE code_verifier is not found in the cache (e.g. due to a cache miss across pods). When `false` (default), it logs a warning and continues without the code_verifier.

env_vars.name: POD_NAME
env_vars.purpose: Pod name for the server, this will be [emitted to `datadog` logs](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/logging#datadog) as `POD_NAME`

env_vars.name: POSTHOG_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for PostHog analytics integration

env_vars.name: POSTHOG_API_URL
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for PostHog API (defaults to https://us.i.posthog.com)

env_vars.name: POSTHOG_MOCK
env_vars.purpose: Enable mock mode for PostHog integration testing. When set to true, intercepts PostHog API calls and returns mock responses without making actual network calls. Default is false

env_vars.name: POSTHOG_MOCK_LATENCY_MS
env_vars.purpose: Mock latency in milliseconds for PostHog API calls when mock mode is enabled. Simulates network round-trip time. Default is 100ms

env_vars.name: PRISMA_AUTH_RECONNECT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Lock timeout in seconds for Prisma auth reconnection. Default is 0.1

env_vars.name: PRISMA_AUTH_RECONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for Prisma auth reconnection attempts. Default is 2.0

env_vars.name: PRISMA_HEALTH_WATCHDOG_ENABLED
env_vars.purpose: Enable the Prisma DB health watchdog that monitors and reconnects on connection loss. Default is true

env_vars.name: PRISMA_HEALTH_WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Interval in seconds for Prisma health watchdog probes. Default is 30

env_vars.name: PRISMA_HEALTH_WATCHDOG_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for each Prisma health probe. Default is 5.0

env_vars.name: PRISMA_RECONNECT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Cooldown in seconds between Prisma reconnection attempts. Default is 15

env_vars.name: PRISMA_RECONNECT_ESCALATION_THRESHOLD
env_vars.purpose: Number of consecutive reconnect failures before escalating the reconnection strategy. Default is 3

env_vars.name: PRISMA_WATCHDOG_RECONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for Prisma watchdog-initiated reconnection. Default is 30.0

env_vars.name: PREDIBASE_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Predibase API

env_vars.name: PRESIDIO_ANALYZER_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Presidio Analyzer service

env_vars.name: PRESIDIO_ANONYMIZER_API_BASE
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Presidio Anonymizer service

env_vars.name: PROMETHEUS_BUDGET_METRICS_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES
env_vars.purpose: Refresh interval in minutes for Prometheus budget metrics. Default is 5

env_vars.name: PROMETHEUS_FALLBACK_STATS_SEND_TIME_HOURS
env_vars.purpose: Fallback time in hours for sending stats to Prometheus. Default is 9

env_vars.name: PROMETHEUS_URL
env_vars.purpose: URL for Prometheus service

env_vars.name: PROMPTLAYER_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for PromptLayer integration

env_vars.name: PROXY_BATCH_POLLING_ENABLED
env_vars.purpose: Set to `false` to disable the `CheckBatchCost` and `CheckResponsesCost` background polling jobs entirely. Useful for emergency mitigation on installs with large numbers of stale managed objects. Default is `true`

env_vars.name: MAX_OBJECTS_PER_POLL_CYCLE
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of managed objects (batches / responses) fetched per polling cycle. Prevents OOM on installs with many stale rows. Default is `50`

env_vars.name: MANAGED_OBJECT_STALENESS_CUTOFF_DAYS
env_vars.purpose: Managed objects older than this many days in a non-terminal state are marked `stale_expired` at the start of each poll cycle and skipped. Default is `7`

env_vars.name: PROXY_BUDGET_RESCHEDULER_MAX_TIME
env_vars.purpose: Maximum time in seconds to wait before checking database for budget resets. Default is 605

env_vars.name: PROXY_BUDGET_RESCHEDULER_MIN_TIME
env_vars.purpose: Minimum time in seconds to wait before checking database for budget resets. Default is 597

env_vars.name: PYTHON_GC_THRESHOLD
env_vars.purpose: GC thresholds ('gen0,gen1,gen2', e.g. '1000,50,50'); defaults to Python’s values.

env_vars.name: PROXY_LOGOUT_URL
env_vars.purpose: URL for logging out of the proxy service

env_vars.name: QDRANT_SCALAR_QUANTILE
env_vars.purpose: Scalar quantile for Qdrant operations. Default is 0.99

env_vars.name: QDRANT_URL
env_vars.purpose: Connection URL for Qdrant database

env_vars.name: QDRANT_VECTOR_SIZE
env_vars.purpose: Vector size for Qdrant operations. Default is 1536

env_vars.name: REDIS_CONNECTION_POOL_TIMEOUT
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for Redis connection pool. Default is 5

env_vars.name: REDIS_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED
env_vars.purpose: When false, the Redis circuit breaker is disabled and never opens. Default is true

env_vars.name: REDIS_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_FAILURE_THRESHOLD
env_vars.purpose: Number of consecutive failures before the Redis circuit breaker opens. Default is 5

env_vars.name: REDIS_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RECOVERY_TIMEOUT
env_vars.purpose: Time in seconds before the Redis circuit breaker attempts recovery after opening. Default is 60

env_vars.name: REDIS_SOCKET_TIMEOUT
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for Redis socket operations. Default is 0.1

env_vars.name: REDIS_GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
env_vars.purpose: GCP service account for IAM authentication with Redis. Format: "projects/-/serviceAccounts/name@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

env_vars.name: REDIS_GCP_SSL_CA_CERTS
env_vars.purpose: Path to SSL CA certificate file for secure GCP Memorystore Redis connections

env_vars.name: REDOC_URL
env_vars.purpose: The path to the Redoc Fast API documentation. **By default this is "/redoc"**

env_vars.name: REPEATED_STREAMING_CHUNK_LIMIT
env_vars.purpose: Limit for repeated streaming chunks to detect looping. Default is 100

env_vars.name: REALTIME_WEBSOCKET_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE_BYTES
env_vars.purpose: Maximum size in bytes for WebSocket messages in realtime connections. Default is None.

env_vars.name: REPLICATE_MODEL_NAME_WITH_ID_LENGTH
env_vars.purpose: Length of Replicate model names with ID. Default is 64

env_vars.name: REPLICATE_POLLING_DELAY_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Delay in seconds for Replicate polling operations. Default is 0.5

env_vars.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for requests. Default is 6000

env_vars.name: ROUTER_MAX_FALLBACKS
env_vars.purpose: Maximum number of fallbacks for router. Default is 5

env_vars.name: RUBRIK_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: Bearer token for authenticating with the Rubrik webhook service

env_vars.name: RUBRIK_BATCH_SIZE
env_vars.purpose: Number of log entries to buffer before flushing to Rubrik. Default is 512

env_vars.name: RUBRIK_SAMPLING_RATE
env_vars.purpose: Fraction of requests to log to Rubrik (0.0 to 1.0). Default is 1.0

env_vars.name: RUBRIK_WEBHOOK_URL
env_vars.purpose: Base URL of the Rubrik webhook service for tool blocking and batch logging

env_vars.name: RUNWAYML_DEFAULT_API_VERSION
env_vars.purpose: Default API version for RunwayML service. Default is "2024-11-06"

env_vars.name: RUNWAYML_POLLING_TIMEOUT
env_vars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for RunwayML image generation polling. Default is 600 (10 minutes)

env_vars.name: S3_VECTORS_DEFAULT_DIMENSION
env_vars.purpose: Default vector dimension for S3 Vectors RAG ingestion. Default is 1024

env_vars.name: S3_VECTORS_DEFAULT_DISTANCE_METRIC
env_vars.purpose: Default distance metric for S3 Vectors RAG ingestion. Options: "cosine", "euclidean". Default is "cosine"

env_vars.name: SECRET_MANAGER_REFRESH_INTERVAL
env_vars.purpose: Refresh interval in seconds for secret manager. Default is 86400 (24 hours)

env_vars.name: SEND_USER_API_KEY_ALIAS
env_vars.purpose: Flag to send user API key alias to Zscaler AI Guard. Default is False

env_vars.name: SEND_USER_API_KEY_TEAM_ID
env_vars.purpose: Flag to send user API key team ID to Zscaler AI Guard. Default is False

env_vars.name: SEND_USER_API_KEY_USER_ID
env_vars.purpose: Flag to send user API key user ID to Zscaler AI Guard. Default is False

env_vars.name: SINGLE_DEPLOYMENT_TRAFFIC_FAILURE_THRESHOLD
env_vars.purpose: Minimum number of requests to consider "reasonable traffic" for single-deployment cooldown logic. Default is 1000

env_vars.name: SLACK_DAILY_REPORT_FREQUENCY
env_vars.purpose: Frequency of daily Slack reports (e.g., daily, weekly)

env_vars.name: SMTP_HOST
env_vars.purpose: Hostname for the SMTP server

env_vars.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
env_vars.purpose: Password for SMTP authentication (do not set if SMTP does not require auth)

env_vars.name: SMTP_PORT
env_vars.purpose: Port number for SMTP server

env_vars.name: SMTP_SENDER_EMAIL
env_vars.purpose: Email address used as the sender in SMTP transactions

env_vars.name: SMTP_SENDER_LOGO
env_vars.purpose: Logo used in emails sent via SMTP

env_vars.name: SMTP_TLS
env_vars.purpose: Flag to enable or disable TLS for SMTP connections

env_vars.name: SMTP_USE_SSL
env_vars.purpose: Set to "True" to force implicit SSL (SMTP_SSL) on any port. Not needed for port 465, which uses implicit SSL automatically; other ports use STARTTLS by default (see SMTP_TLS)

env_vars.name: SMTP_USERNAME
env_vars.purpose: Username for SMTP authentication (do not set if SMTP does not require auth)

env_vars.name: SENDGRID_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for SendGrid email service

env_vars.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Resend email service

env_vars.name: SENDGRID_SENDER_EMAIL
env_vars.purpose: Email address used as the sender in SendGrid email transactions

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOGS_URL
env_vars.purpose: URL for retrieving spend logs

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOG_CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE
env_vars.purpose: Number of logs deleted per batch during cleanup. Default is 1000

env_vars.name: STALE_OBJECT_CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE
env_vars.purpose: Max number of stale managed objects updated per cleanup cycle. Default is 1000

env_vars.name: SSL_CERTIFICATE
env_vars.purpose: Path to the SSL certificate file

env_vars.name: SSL_ECDH_CURVE
env_vars.purpose: ECDH curve for SSL/TLS key exchange (e.g., 'X25519' to disable PQC).

env_vars.name: SSL_SECURITY_LEVEL
env_vars.purpose: [BETA] Security level for SSL/TLS connections. E.g. `DEFAULT@SECLEVEL=1`

env_vars.name: SSL_VERIFY
env_vars.purpose: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification

env_vars.name: SSL_CERT_FILE
env_vars.purpose: Path to the SSL certificate file for custom CA bundle

env_vars.name: SUPABASE_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Supabase service

env_vars.name: SUPABASE_URL
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Supabase instance

env_vars.name: SYSTEM_MESSAGE_TOKEN_COUNT
env_vars.purpose: Token count for system messages. Default is 4

env_vars.name: TEST_EMAIL_ADDRESS
env_vars.purpose: Email address used for testing purposes

env_vars.name: TOGETHER_AI_4_B
env_vars.purpose: Size parameter for Together AI 4B model. Default is 4

env_vars.name: TOGETHER_AI_8_B
env_vars.purpose: Size parameter for Together AI 8B model. Default is 8

env_vars.name: TOGETHER_AI_21_B
env_vars.purpose: Size parameter for Together AI 21B model. Default is 21

env_vars.name: TOGETHER_AI_41_B
env_vars.purpose: Size parameter for Together AI 41B model. Default is 41

env_vars.name: TOGETHER_AI_80_B
env_vars.purpose: Size parameter for Together AI 80B model. Default is 80

env_vars.name: TOGETHER_AI_110_B
env_vars.purpose: Size parameter for Together AI 110B model. Default is 110

env_vars.name: TOGETHER_AI_EMBEDDING_150_M
env_vars.purpose: Size parameter for Together AI 150M embedding model. Default is 150

env_vars.name: TOGETHER_AI_EMBEDDING_350_M
env_vars.purpose: Size parameter for Together AI 350M embedding model. Default is 350

env_vars.name: TOOL_CHOICE_OBJECT_TOKEN_COUNT
env_vars.purpose: Token count for tool choice objects. Default is 4

env_vars.name: TOOL_POLICY_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: TTL in seconds for caching tool policy guardrail results. Default is 60

env_vars.name: UI_LOGO_PATH
env_vars.purpose: Path to the logo image used in the UI

env_vars.name: UPSTREAM_LANGFUSE_DEBUG
env_vars.purpose: Flag to enable debugging for upstream Langfuse

env_vars.name: UPSTREAM_LANGFUSE_HOST
env_vars.purpose: Host URL for upstream Langfuse service

env_vars.name: UPSTREAM_LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY
env_vars.purpose: Public key for upstream Langfuse authentication

env_vars.name: UPSTREAM_LANGFUSE_RELEASE
env_vars.purpose: Release version identifier for upstream Langfuse

env_vars.name: UPSTREAM_LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
env_vars.purpose: Secret key for upstream Langfuse authentication

env_vars.name: USE_AWS_KMS
env_vars.purpose: Flag to enable AWS Key Management Service for encryption

env_vars.name: USE_PRISMA_MIGRATE
env_vars.purpose: Flag to use prisma migrate instead of prisma db push. Recommended for production environments.

env_vars.name: VANTAGE_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Vantage cost-import integration

env_vars.name: VANTAGE_BASE_URL
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Vantage API. Default is `https://api.vantage.sh`

env_vars.name: VANTAGE_EXPORT_FREQUENCY
env_vars.purpose: Export frequency for Vantage — `hourly` (default), `daily`, or `interval`

env_vars.name: VANTAGE_EXPORT_INTERVAL_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Interval in seconds when VANTAGE_EXPORT_FREQUENCY is `interval`

env_vars.name: VANTAGE_INTEGRATION_TOKEN
env_vars.purpose: Vantage integration token for the cost-import endpoint

env_vars.name: WANDB_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Weights & Biases (W&B) logging integration

env_vars.name: WANDB_HOST
env_vars.purpose: Host URL for Weights & Biases (W&B) service

env_vars.name: WANDB_PROJECT_ID
env_vars.purpose: Project ID for Weights & Biases (W&B) logging integration

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOG_RUN_LOOPS
env_vars.purpose: Constant for setting how many runs of 1000 batch deletes should spend_log_cleanup task run

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOG_PARTITION_INTERVAL
env_vars.purpose: Granularity of LiteLLM_SpendLogs partitions when the table is partitioned: day, week, or month. Default is day

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOG_PARTITION_PRECREATE_AHEAD
env_vars.purpose: Number of future spend-log partitions to pre-create on each cleanup run. Default is 7

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOG_QUEUE_POLL_INTERVAL
env_vars.purpose: Polling interval in seconds for spend log queue. Default is 2.0

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOG_QUEUE_SIZE_THRESHOLD
env_vars.purpose: Threshold for spend log queue size before processing. Default is 100

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOG_CLEANUP_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_BATCH_FAILURES
env_vars.purpose: Number of consecutive batch failures tolerated before the spend log cleanup run aborts. Default is 3

env_vars.name: SPEND_LOG_CLEANUP_BATCH_FAILURE_BACKOFF_SECONDS
env_vars.purpose: Backoff in seconds between failed spend log cleanup batches. Default is 0.5

env_vars.name: SPEND_COUNTER_RESEED_LOCKS_MAX_SIZE
env_vars.purpose: Max size of the per-counter LRU lock dict used to coalesce concurrent spend-counter reseeds from the DB on the enforcement path. Default is 10000.

env_vars.name: COROUTINE_CHECKER_MAX_SIZE_IN_MEMORY
env_vars.purpose: Maximum size for CoroutineChecker in-memory cache. Default is 1000

env_vars.name: DEFAULT_SHARED_HEALTH_CHECK_TTL
env_vars.purpose: Time-to-live in seconds for cached health check results in shared health check mode. Default is 300 (5 minutes)

env_vars.name: DEFAULT_SHARED_HEALTH_CHECK_LOCK_TTL
env_vars.purpose: Time-to-live in seconds for health check lock in shared health check mode. Default is 60 (1 minute)

env_vars.name: ZSCALER_AI_GUARD_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Zscaler AI Guard service

env_vars.name: ZSCALER_AI_GUARD_POLICY_ID
env_vars.purpose: Policy ID for Zscaler AI Guard guardrails

env_vars.name: ZSCALER_AI_GUARD_URL
env_vars.purpose: Base URL for Zscaler AI Guard API. Default is https://api.us1.zseclipse.net/v1/detection/execute-policy
